text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Looking at the results from the last 
race, I found a lot of areas where I need 
to improve.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel I was able to put 
forth my absolute best effort within the 
limited time available.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...So that I will never have to experience 
that feeling again.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, next time I'll definitely bring back 
the best result with no regrets♪
